title: SET junks quo warranto motion vs. Erwin Tulfo
summary: Voting 6-3, the Senate Electoral Tribunal has dismissed the motion for reconsideration for the dismissal of the quo warranto petition filed against Senator Erwin Tulfo by Berteni Causing.
